Privacy

Who we are

This website belongs to Overseas Tyre And Services Sdn Bhd, 2, Jalan Indah 16/11, Taman Bukit Indah, 81200 Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia.

What we collect

The site has no forms. When you tap WhatsApp, call or email, you contact us directly through that app, and we only see what you send us.

Button taps

We count taps on our WhatsApp, call, email, map and Facebook buttons to see which parts of the site help drivers. This count uses a random visit code, the page and the button, and does not identify you.

Maps

The contact page shows a Google Maps map. Google may set its own cookies when the map loads.

Your requests

To ask about your information, email overseastyrebi@gmail.com or WhatsApp 018-234 1322.
